name: WilL!
source:
Upon death people don't disappear. They turn into stars. So pass them with a smile.
Main character lives happily with his sister. This is a kind and slightly sad story about him starting a new part-time job.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-october-2007-boku-ga-sadame.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
人死后并不会消失。他们变成了星星。所以微笑着与他们告别吧。主人公和妹妹幸福地生活着。这是一个关于他开始新兼职的温馨而略带忧伤的故事。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-october-2007-boku-ga-sadame.html]vndbreview[/url]]
